item.title: Nearly 9 in 10 Americans report widespread government corruption after Trump's return
item.description: Gallup data shows Americans' perceptions of government corruption have hit a 20-year high following President Trump's return to office.

item.title: Executions on the rise in the United States
item.description: Florida carried out its 14th execution of the year on Tuesday, contributing to a national increase in executions, according to data from the Death Penalty Information Center.

item.title: Lutnick says Anthropic is now aligned with Trump administration
item.description: Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick stated that the Trump administration now trusts Anthropic after months of disputes with the AI company.

item.title: New $1 Trump coins: legal to spend, but with complications
item.description: The U.S. Mint started selling $1 Trump coins on Wednesday. They are promoted as collectibles, but spending them is legal, though it may present practical challenges.
